# MediaPipe webcam resources

- Runtime: Google MediaPipe `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 0.10.32, installed from the npm package and supplied under Apache 2.0. See LICENSE.
- Model: Google MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Lite, float16 version 1 from https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task
- [Model documentation](https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker)

The dashboard downloads these resources from its own origin when webcam detection is opened.
